title: Concept: Angular sanitizer bypass in a bundle
description: A call to Angular's bypassSecurityTrust family in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: These methods mark a value as trusted without sanitising it, so Angular stops escaping it; a bundle that calls them tells a reader where the framework's protection is switched off.
applicability: A bypassed value is inserted as markup with no further check, which is a direct path to script execution.
risk: The sanitizer is Angular's defence; bypassSecurityTrust is the documented way to disable it.
